title: Unify remaining paired console routes: realtime, bootstrap, notifications, telemetry
description:
Goal: finish the one-handler-per-route work in rust/src/bin/console_local.rs (follows PR #470, which did the wiki handlers). Pure refactor: no observable behavior change for any route.

Pairs still duplicated (root handler plus /:account/:project handler, registered separately in main()):
- GET /api/events/realtime: get_realtime_events_root, get_realtime_events
- GET /api/realtime/bootstrap: get_realtime_bootstrap_root, get_realtime_bootstrap
- GET /api/auth/bootstrap: get_auth_bootstrap_root, get_auth_bootstrap
- POST /api/notifications: post_notification_root, post_notification
- POST /api/telemetry/console: post_console_telemetry_root, post_console_telemetry
- GET /api/telemetry/console/events: get_console_telemetry_events_root, get_console_telemetry_events
- GET /api/ui-state: root only (get_ui_state_root). Keep it root only; do not add a tenant route.

Work:
1. Add a fn tenant_api_routes() -> Router<AppState> (sibling of store_api_routes()) holding the six paired routes, and register it the same way store_api_routes is: .merge(tenant_api_routes()) and .nest("/:account/:project", tenant_api_routes()). Remove the twelve separate .route calls from main().
2. Replace each pair with one handler that takes the existing TenantSelection extractor (do not use resolve_store here: these routes must keep working at root in multi-tenant mode, exactly as today). Telemetry passes the selection tuple into build_telemetry_payload; bootstrap handlers pass account/project as today; notification and realtime handlers ignore the selection as today.
3. Rename the surviving handlers without the _root suffix. Keep get_ui_state_root's route path unchanged (rename it get_ui_state).
4. Do not change UI-state or notification tenant scoping (that leak is a separate behavior-change ticket). Do not touch the index/asset routes.
5. Add tokio tests in the existing mod tests covering, for at least telemetry POST and realtime bootstrap: the root route and the tenant route both respond with the same status as before, and the tenant route's payload carries account/project. Also assert an invalid tenant segment returns 400 (the extractor behavior).

Constraints: Rust only; the PR carries the parity-exempt label (no Python counterpart for console_local). No line comments; rustdoc on new items. cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean.

Acceptance:
- grep -c '_root(' rust/src/bin/console_local.rs counts only get_index_root/get_asset_root style asset handlers and store_for_root, nothing from the list above.
- main() has no '/:account/:project/api/' route strings.
- cargo test --bin kbsc passes (or the actual console_local bin name), fmt and clippy clean.
- PR into develop, labeled parity-exempt, CI green.

comments.text: Merged in PR #473: tenant_api_routes() serves realtime events, realtime bootstrap, auth bootstrap, notifications and both telemetry routes with one handler each; tests cover root and tenant paths and the 400 on invalid tenant segments. CI green.
